description.value: The Bailey Theatre is the primary performing arts venue for Trail and the surrounding Kootenays region, with a seating capacity of 721 and an intimate atmosphere where all seats have good sightlines. Operated by the Trail & District Arts Council, it hosts a wide range of events from major touring acts to classical and jazz series. A smaller adjacent space, the Muriel Griffiths Recital Room, accommodates 80–100 people for chamber performances, meetings, and community events.

Café or food on site.detail: Website states: 'Our bar and concession are open at most shows for your convenience, and our food and drink items are permitted in the theatre.' Available at most (not all) events

wow_evidence: Trail's 721-seat primary performing-arts venue; delight show-conditional per rubric.
blurb: The Kootenays' 721-seat main theatre in Trail; delight depends on a show being on.
